s1.title: Hum kaun hain
s1.body: TezDukan Hyderabad, Sindh ka platform hai jo dukanon ko distributors aur customers se jorta hai. App use kar ke aap in terms se ittefaq karte hain.

s2.title: Aap ka account
s2.body: Apna mobile number use karein aur password kisi ko na batayein. Aap ke account aur aap ke add kiye gaye staff ke orders ki zimmedari aap ki hai.

s3.title: Orders aur qeematein
s3.body: Har distributor apni qeematein, stock aur schemes khud tay karta hai. Distributor ke accept karne par order pakka hota hai. Bare orders dispatch se pehle phone par confirm ho sakte hain.

s4.title: Payment aur khata
s4.body: Delivery par cash ya distributor ki ijazat se khate (udhaar) par payment karein. Wajibaat aur payments aap ke statement mein darj hoti hain aur delete nahi hotin, sirf reverse ho sakti hain.

s5.title: Sahi istemal
s5.body: App ka ghalat istemal, ghalat maloomat ya doosron ke data tak pohanchne ki koshish na karein. Rules torne wale accounts band ho sakte hain.

s1.title: Hum kya jama karte hain
s1.body: Aap ka naam, mobile number, email (sirf Google se sign in par), dukan ya karobar ki tafseel, jo location aap share karein, orders, payments aur app mein bheje gaye messages. Mic istemal karne par aap ki awaaz ko likhai mein badla jata hai aur mehfooz nahi kiya jata. Android app kharabi ki report (phone model, Android version aur kharabi) bhejti hai taake hum masle theek kar sakein.

s2.title: Kyun use karte hain
s2.body: Account banane, order pohanchane, khata rakhne, order updates aur notifications bhejne, madad dene aur service mehfooz rakhne ke liye.

s3.title: Kaun dekh sakta hai
s3.body: Jis dukan ya distributor se aap order karein, wo us order ke liye aap ka naam, phone aur delivery ka pata dekhta hai. Hum aap ka data kabhi nahi bechte. Service providers sirf hamare liye kaam karte hain: Supabase (database), Vercel (hosting), SMS service, aur Google Gemini jo Munshi ke jawab deta hai aur awaaz ko likhai mein badalta hai.

s4.title: Aap ke ikhtiyarat
s4.body: Aap kisi bhi waqt phone notifications band kar sakte hain aur apni tafseel badal sakte hain. Account aur data delete karne ke liye Account → Mera account delete karein kholein, ya tezdukan.vercel.app/data-deletion par jayein. Hum 30 din ke andar mukammal karte hain.

s5.title: Hifazat
s5.body: Aap ka data mehfooz servers par encrypt ho kar rakha jata hai, aur har dukan aur distributor sirf apna record dekh sakta hai.

s1.title: Kharab ya kam maal
s1.body: Kharab, expire ya kam maal ki shikayat delivery ke 48 ghante ke andar order ke page se karein, ho sake to photo ke saath.

s2.title: Refund kaise hota hai
s2.body: Approve shikayat ki raqam distributor ke saath aap ke khate mein jama hoti hai, ya usi tareeqe se wapas milti hai jis se aap ne payment ki. Har shikayat ka faisla distributor karta hai.

s3.title: Cancel orders
s3.body: Packing se pehle order cancel kar sakte hain. Agar payment ho chuki ho to poori raqam wapas milegi.
